name: FLARE
description: A dungeon-based rope weekend designed for intermediate to advanced practitioners. The 4 day weekend features advanced classes, demonstrations, and playtime in the Woodshed dungeon all night long! NEW THIS YEAR: Longer & larger class blocks! 4 days of education — Thursday, Friday, Saturday & Sunday! BONUS THIS YEAR: Self-tie class block on Sunday! We will be offering two self-tie classes (intermediate & advanced). These are included in your full FLARE 2026 ticket, but a separate $25 per person ticket is available for Sunday only. The class list is coming soon — be advised that these are advanced level classes. Both tops and bottoms should be beyond the basics and prepared for an intense weekend of rope!

tickets.pairsNote: Tickets are sold as a tying pair for maximum learning benefit
